content:
Last weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, Apple TV announced a series of updates, including the premiere date for the fourth season of "Silo."

"Silo" season 4 will premiere in the summer of 2027 and will be the show's final season.

Season 3 of "Silo" is currently airing (you can watch it here), with new episodes released weekly until September 4.

However, at last weekend's San Diego Comic-Con, in addition to "Silo" announcements, Apple also brought surprises for fans of several other sci-fi series.

"Silo" season 4 will debut next summer, bringing the entire series to a close.

Below is the announcement Apple TV posted on social media platform X:

In the streaming era, a show sometimes has to wait several years before a new season premieres, especially for large-scale sci-fi productions like "Silo."

However, Apple has always been proactive, renewing some shows early to speed up their return. Taking "Silo" as an example, seasons 3 and 4 were developed simultaneously and filmed back-to-back.

We still have six weeks to slowly savor the afterglow of this new season of "Silo." But after this season ends, fans won't have to wait long, because season 4 will follow very soon.

What are your thoughts on the current season 3 of "Silo"? Feel free to share in the comments below.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, but you can get a discount by subscribing through the Apple One bundle.
